subject: Discovery: Private/VPC security posture — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery: Private/VPC security posture — next steps

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — great call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on security posture and deployment constraints for Acme Analytics: 

1) Recap from our side
- You're evaluating a Private/VPC deployment of Redwood to satisfy data residency and network isolation requirements.
- Primary regulatory drivers: GDPR (EU data subjects) and SOC 2 for your analytics product. Potential HIPAA scope for one pilot integration.
- Key asks from your security team: SOC 2 Type II evidence (redacted), vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) completion, high-level deployment/network diagram showing VPC peering and egress controls, and confirmation on air-gapped/on-prem options.

2) Proposed next steps
- I'll share our redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a starter SSQ for your security team to review (see attachments/links below).
- Marcus (cc'd) — can you please add a technical owner for a short walk-through of our VPC deployment options and the diagram artifacts we usually provide?
- Sophie — if you can confirm which environments (prod/staging) need private connectivity and whether you require an on-prem/air-gapped option, we can tailor the diagram.
- We recommend a 30-min technical deep-dive with your infra/security lead next week to go over network flows, KMS/HSM options, and audit logging.

Attachments/links: redwood-network-diagram.pdf (stub), vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (SSQ starter), SOC2-type2-report-redacted.pdf (redacted). Also posting the SSQ in our secure portal: https://redwoodhq.app/ssq/ACME-45821

Proposed times for the tech deep-dive: 2028-04-06 09:00-09:30 PT, 2028-04-06 13:00-13:30 PT. Let me know what works and I'll send an invite.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: ITSecurity Team <security@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery: Private/VPC security posture — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses below and a couple of items from our side.

Thanks for sending the starter SSQ and SOC2 redacted report. I attached a short list of additional questions from our risk team (see inline). We can start with the SSQ; I'll assign this to our vendor ops queue and you should see a status update in the portal.

On scope:
- We need private connectivity for prod only initially; staging can use a restricted public endpoint.
- We have a strict egress policy: only approved IPs and enforced TLS. We will need to validate how Redwood handles outbound telemetry and 3rd-party service calls.
- Air-gapped: for now we don't require a fully air-gapped install, but we need an on-prem option evaluated in case of future classification changes.

Availability for the tech deep-dive: 2028-04-06 13:00 PT works for our infra lead (Erin Park). Please include Marcus and your infra engineer.

Inline questions from our risk team (high level):
1) Data at rest encryption: full-disk vs. object-level; key rotation cadence and KMS providers supported (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, customer-managed HSM).
2) Audit logging retention options and how logs are ingested/exported to our SIEM (we use Splunk).
3) Network diagram: need to confirm whether we can peer into an isolated VPC with no public subnets and whether NAT/gateway egress is required for management/control plane.
4) SOC 2: can you confirm vendor attest period and whether you provide the bridge letter for interim periods?

I've attached the short list as a text stub (security-questions.txt) and will start the SSQ in your portal. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sophie Chen
Head of Security Operations
Acme Analytics
sophie.chen@acme.com

This diagram notes where we can remove public subnets for an on-prem-like footprint.

For the tech deep-dive: calendar invite sent for 2028-04-06 13:00-13:30 PT with Marcus (infra lead) and our platform engineer (Deloitte placeholder). If you want Marcus to include additional runbook artifacts (audit log schemas, retention settings, Splunk ingestion example), he'll bring those.

- SSQ completion ETA from Acme (Sophie) — if you can provide a target date I'll mark it in the deal plan.

Thanks again. If anything urgent comes up, Marcus and I are available.
